text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending prohibiting standing on both sides of the north/south leg of Archer Street, between Cobourg Avenue and the east/west leg of Archer Street. The proposed changes will deter parking at this location and improve safety and traffic operations by maintaining unobstructed sightlines and a clear passage for vehicles on the two-way street. During the investigation, Transportation Services discovered inconsistencies in the traffic by-law related to the current signed parking regulations on Archer Street and Coburg Avenue. Recommendations 2 to 5 will rectify these inconsistencies.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on both sides of the north/south leg of Archer Street, between Cobourg Avenue and the east/west leg of Archer Street. 2. Rescinded the existing permit parking regulation in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily, on the even (west) side of Archer Street, from Cobourg Avenue to Archer Street. 3. Authorized permit parking to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily, on the even (north) side of Archer Street from the north/south leg of Archer Street to the east end of Archer Street. 4. Rescinded the existing permit parking regulation in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily, except no parking first day to the 15th day of each month, inclusive, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, and no parking anytime from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the next following year, inclusive; and no…
